title: 2026 contribution rates, as printed on the bill
alt: Notice page from a National Health Insurance Service statement stating the 2026 employee health insurance rate of 7.19% and long-term care rate of 0.9448%
note: The rates this site quotes, printed on an actual statement rather than taken from a guide: employee health insurance 7.19%, long-term care 0.9448%. Long-term care is expressed here as a percentage of income, which is the figure that reconciles with the 13.14%-of-the-health-contribution formulation used elsewhere.
redaction: Nothing removed. This page of the notice carries no identifying information — it is the standard guidance printed for every recipient.
